title: Delaunay spatial network
intent: Expose local adjacency among real automobile weight and fuel-economy observations by connecting every edge of a Delaunay triangulation.

ai.create: Create a quantitative point diagram from automobile weight and fuel economy that connects all unique final-screen Delaunay neighbors using each library's native Delaunay link mark.
ai.maintain: Change the selected cars while preserving final-screen topology, both endpoint records, stable point-derived edge keys, and cast-free source channels.
